note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The context is the desk after the review frame was laid over the supplied range (routes.from..routes.to). ONE supplied datum is substituted: where the frame's focus edge stands (beforeValue → afterValue on its edge tag; afterIndex gives the new section). Only that rail and its tag change; a ghost outline keeps the old position traceable and a neutral Δ marker stays. 'Inside / outside the frame' in the legend describes supplied geometry only; nothing about what a review may cover, validity or outcome is inferred. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable (afterIndex sets the new edge section).
